image.title: Image
image.description: Optional input image. Images are priced as (width px * height px)/750 input tokens

effort.title: effort
effort.description: How much thinking Claude does before responding. Opus 5.5 always uses adaptive thinking; higher effort improves quality on hard coding and agentic tasks, but is slower and uses more output tokens. 'low' is the fastest and cheapest.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens, including thinking tokens. Opus 5.5 always thinks before responding, so leave headroom at higher effort levels (Anthropic recommends starting at 64000 for 'xhigh' and 'max').

max_image_resolution.title: Max Image Resolution
max_image_resolution.description: Maximum image resolution in megapixels. Scales down image before sending it to Claude, to save time and money.
